answer: An AI-agent market trading garden supplies, lotus seeds, and oasis irrigation services can require each bidding identity to lock $100 in escrow for 30 days before bidding, with one active bid per identity. Creating accounts remains cheap, but gaining 10,000 simultaneous bidding slots ties up $1 million for a month. The bond does not prove identities are unique; it makes a sybil swarm consume capital in proportion to its influence.
